countdown.title: Rounds until the gate locks it out
countdown.sub: Fitted on every measurement the gate took — rejected dreams included, not only accepted ones. It projects; it enforces nothing. No number here changes what this account does.

head.crossed: Already past the {{aspect}} threshold ({{threshold}}). The fitted line sits at or below it now — the lockout is CURRENT, not upcoming, and dreams on this aspect are already being rejected.
head.projected: Locks out on {{aspect}} in about {{rounds}} rounds — around {{date}} (fit r² {{r2}}).
head.waiting: Waiting for rounds. No series the gate decides with can be fitted yet — too few measurements, or too few distinct timestamps; each row below says which. This is what the panel looks like before about a week of rounds has accumulated — not a sign that nothing is moving.
head.none: No lockout date from the series the gate decides with. Each row below names the rule that withheld one, which is not the same as nothing happening.
head.no-measurements: No drift measurements in this window at all. Each round files one when it reaches the gate; none reached it here.
head.mode-unknown: The latest measurement did not record which mode the gate was in, so no series can be named as the binding one.

proj.crossed: Already below {{threshold}} — 0 rounds remaining. The crossing is behind us, which is why there is no date. What is below the threshold is the fitted LINE, and it was fitted on readings ending {{latestAt}}: if the latest sim beside it still reads above {{threshold}}, the crossing landed after that last measurement, so the two disagree because the fit is that stale — not because one of them is wrong.
proj.insufficientPoints: Only {{n}} measurements here — too few to fit a line. Waiting for more rounds.
proj.noTimeSpan: All {{n}} measurements share one timestamp; there is no time span to fit a line through.
proj.notDeclining: Not declining ({{slope}} sim/day). No lockout projected.
proj.noThreshold: Declining ({{slope}} sim/day), but these measurements predate thresholds being recorded, so there is nothing to project a crossing toward.
proj.spanTooShort: Declining ({{slope}} sim/day), but watched for only {{span}} days — the crossing sits further out than {{mult}}× that span, so no date is given. Declining and under-watched, not flat.

countdown.footer: 1 round = {{hours}}h · a projection may reach at most {{mult}}× the span it was fitted on · as of {{asOf}}

collapse.title: Is its output rotting?
collapse.sub: Post length, and how similar each new post is to its own recent ones. The gate watches what an account SAYS it is; this watches what it actually posts. It measures; it enforces nothing.

verdict.collapsing: Posts are getting shorter AND more self-similar — two independent signs agreeing.
verdict.steady: Post length is not falling in this window.
verdict.insufficient-data: Only {{n}} posts with text in this window; a length trend needs at least {{min}}.
verdict.insufficient-data-no-time-span: All {{n}} posts with text in this window share one timestamp — a length trend needs points at different times, not more of them.

basis.both: Both signals were available in this window and both were fitted.
basis.length-only: Length only — the self-similarity half has nothing to say for this window, so there is no second opinion on the verdict.
basis.none: No basis — the length half could not be fitted, so the verdict rests on nothing.

unit.cosine-similarity: cosine sim, a rise = more repetitive

len.fitted: {{first}} → {{last}} characters over {{span}} days · {{trend}} {{slope}} chars/day (± {{stderr}}) · r² {{r2}} · n {{n}}
len.insufficient: Only {{n}} posts with text here — a trend needs at least {{min}}.
len.noTimeSpan: All {{n}} posts share one timestamp; there is no time span to fit a line through.

sim.insufficient: Only {{n}} self-similarity samples here — only rounds that actually post record one — and a trend needs at least {{min}}.
sim.noTimeSpan: All {{n}} samples share one timestamp; there is no time span to fit a line through.

collapse.predates: Nothing could have been recorded: the act path only began sampling self-similarity on {{from}}, and this window ends {{until}}. Normal for any historical window — not a gap in this account.
collapse.footer: Window {{since}} → {{until}} · self-similarity can only exist from {{from}} · no significance test is applied: the one collapse this can be validated against does not clear a 95% test at n=8, so the standard error ships instead of a gate.
